'''Version 1.9.21''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on May 25th 2024.  It was 25.77 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Fixes</u>====
*Fix stray pixel on Virulent Bolster texture
*Fix wrong mod version being reported internally
*Fix some configuration options default values not working

====<u>Compatibility</u>====
*Mod Compatibility module & framework has been introduced
*For mod + addon developer Modrome is now handling mod and addon compatibility inquiries
*Function Deprecation warnings have been added and will show up on logs as a warning
*Users will be warned in logs if they have JEID or REID installed, due to known incompatiblity.  ''[Notify Modrome if there's a patch to REID.]''
*Deprecation: SRPExplotion() replaced with SRPExplosion()

====<u>Internal</u>====
*Code cleanups for performance improvements
